description: Build the unsigned calls that sell a wallet's PT-USDG for USDG at the market before maturity, on Robinhood Chain: an approval of exactly that PT-USDG to Pendle's router, if needed, then the router's swap, paying the USDG to the wallet itself with a minimum out. Nothing is signed or sent. Read-only.

amount_pt.description: PT-USDG, e.g. 25.5, or "all" for the whole balance.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage margin in basis points under the quote, 0 to 500. Default 100 (1%), 10 for a redemption.

name: pt_sell
title: Calls to sell PT-USDG
